+import { headers } from "next/headers";
+import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
+import { auth } from "@/lib/auth";
+import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
+import CalendarView from "./calendarView";
+
+export default async function CalendarPage() {
+  const session = await auth.api.getSession({ headers: await headers() });
+
+  if (!session?.user) {
+    redirect("/login");
+  }
+
+  const posts = await prisma.posts.findMany({
+    where: {
+      userId: session.user.id,
+      ScheduledFor: { not: null },
+    },
+    orderBy: { ScheduledFor: "asc" },
+  });
+
+  const events = posts.map((post) => ({
+    id: post.id,
+    title: post.content.length > 40 ? post.content.slice(0, 40) + "…" : post.content,
+    start: post.ScheduledFor!.toISOString(),
+    extendedProps: {
+      description: post.content,
+      platforms: post.platforms,
+      media: post.media,
+      status: post.status,
+    },
+  }));
+
+  return <CalendarView events={events} />;
 }

diff --git a/src/app/calendar/calendarView.tsx b/src/app/calendar/calendarView.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..656d645
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/app/calendar/calendarView.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+"use client";
+
+import FullCalendar from "@fullcalendar/react";
+import dayGridPlugin from "@fullcalendar/daygrid";
+import timeGridPlugin from "@fullcalendar/timegrid";
+import SideNav from "@/components/Sidenav";
+import Card from "@/components/Card";
+import Charts from "./_sections/Charts";
+import { useRef } from "react";
+import { TriangleAlert, BellRing } from "lucide-react";
+
+interface CalendarEvent {
+  id: string;
+  title: string;
+  start: string;
+  extendedProps: {
+    description: string;
+    platforms: string[];
+    media: string;
+    status: string;
+  };
+}
+
+interface CalendarViewProps {
+  events: CalendarEvent[];
+}
+
+export default function CalendarView({ events }: CalendarViewProps) {
+  const hoverTooltipRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
+  const pinnedTooltipRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
+
+  const createTooltip = (info: any) => {
+    const tooltip = document.createElement("div");
+    tooltip.className = "calendar-tooltip";
+    tooltip.innerHTML = `
+        <div class="flex flex-col">
+            <strong>${info.event.extendedProps.platforms?.join(", ") || info.event.title}</strong><br>
+            <img src="${info.event.extendedProps.media || ""}" alt="Media" class="tooltip-media" width="100"/>
+            <span>${info.event.extendedProps.status || ""}</span>
+        </div>
+        "${info.event.extendedProps.description || "No description"}"<br>
+        Fecha: ${info.event.start.toLocaleString()}
+    `;
+    document.body.appendChild(tooltip);
+    tooltip.style.left = info.jsEvent.pageX + 10 + "px";
+    tooltip.style.top = info.jsEvent.pageY + 10 + "px";
+    return tooltip;
+  };
+
+  const renderEventContent = (eventInfo: any) => {
+    const { media, platforms, status } = eventInfo.event.extendedProps;
+
+    return (
+        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 overflow-hidden p-0.5 w-full">
+        {media && (
+            <img src={media} alt="post" className="w-12 h-12 rounded object-cover shrink-0" />
+        )}
+        <span className="text-xs truncate">
+            {platforms?.[0]}
+            {platforms?.length > 1 ? ` +${platforms.length - 1}` : ""}
+        </span>
+        </div>
+    );
+};
+
+  const removeTooltip = (ref: any) => {
+    if (ref.current) {
+      ref.current.remove();
+      ref.current = null;
+    }
+  };
+
+  const handleEventMouseEnter = (info: any) => {
+    if (pinnedTooltipRef.current) return;
+    hoverTooltipRef.current = createTooltip(info);
+  };
+
+  const handleEventMouseLeave = () => {
+    removeTooltip(hoverTooltipRef);
+  };
+
+  const handleDateClick = (info: any) => {
+    if (pinnedTooltipRef.current) {
+      removeTooltip(pinnedTooltipRef);
+      return;
+    }
+    removeTooltip(hoverTooltipRef);
+    pinnedTooltipRef.current = createTooltip(info);
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <main className="mx-auto bg-indigo-10 flex bg-slate-50">
+      <SideNav />
+
+      <section id="calendar" className="calendar-container container py-20 px-20 mt-10">
+        <div className="mb-10">
+          <FullCalendar
+            plugins={[dayGridPlugin, timeGridPlugin]}
+            headerToolbar={{
+              start: "prev,next today",
+              center: "title",
+              end: "dayGridMonth,dayGridWeek,timeGridDay",
+            }}
+            initialView="dayGridMonth"
+            locale="es"
+            fixedWeekCount={false}
+            height="600px"
+            events={events}
+            editable={false}
+            eventContent={renderEventContent}
+            eventMouseEnter={handleEventMouseEnter}
+            eventMouseLeave={handleEventMouseLeave}
+            eventClick={handleDateClick}
+            slotDuration="00:30:00"
+            slotLabelFormat={{ hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false }}
+            slotMinTime="06:00:00"
+            slotMaxTime="22:00:00"
+            allDaySlot={true}
+          />
+        </div>
+
+        <div className="grid grid-cols-12 gap-5">
+          <Card className="content-error-messages col-span-4">
+            <h4 className="mb-5">Brecha de contenido</h4>
+            <div className="content-message flex flex-row mb-5">
+              <div className="icon_info p-3 bg-red-200 rounded-md text-red-600 mr-2 w-fit">
+                <TriangleAlert />
+              </div>
+              <div className="flex flex-col text-sm content-center">
+                <div className="font-bold">Semana 4 sin posts</div>
+                <div>Sin posts el dia 04 de Octubre</div>
+              </div>
+            </div>
+            <div className="content-message flex flex-row mb-5">
+              <div className="icon_info p-3 bg-yellow-200 rounded-md text-yellow-600 mr-2 w-fit">
+                <BellRing />
+              </div>
+              <div className="flex flex-col text-sm content-center">
+                <div className="font-bold">Oportunidad de post</div>
+                <div>Mejor tiempo: Hoy a las 8:00am</div>
+              </div>
+            </div>
+          </Card>
+          <Card className="campain-performance col-span-8">
+            <Charts />
+          </Card>
+        </div>
+      </section>
+    </main>
+  );
+}
\ No newline at end of file

diff --git a/src/app/post/action.tsx b/src/app/post/action.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0d4c088
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/app/post/action.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,128 @@
+"use server"
+
+import { headers } from "next/headers";
+import { writeFile, mkdir } from "fs/promises";
+import path from "path";
+import { auth } from "@/lib/auth";
+import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
+
+import { postSchema } from "./schema";
+
+const initialState: ActionResponse = {
+    success: false,
+    message: "",
+};
+
+export async function createPost(
+  prevState: ActionResponse,
+  formData: FormData
+): Promise<ActionResponse> {
+  const session = await auth.api.getSession({ headers: await headers() });
+
+  if (!session?.user) {
+    return {
+      ...initialState,
+      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
+      success: false,
+      errors: { _form: ["Debes iniciar sesión para publicar."] },
+    };
+  }
+
+  const raw = {
+    content: formData.get("content")?.toString() ?? "",
+    platforms: formData.getAll("platforms").map((p) => p.toString()),
+    scheduleEnabled: formData.get("scheduleEnabled")?.toString() ?? "false",
+    scheduledDate: formData.get("scheduledDate")?.toString() || undefined,
+    scheduledTime: formData.get("scheduledTime")?.toString() || undefined,
+  };
+
+  const parsed = postSchema.safeParse(raw);
+
+  if (!parsed.success) {
+    return {
+      ...initialState,
+      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
+      success: false,
+      errors: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
+    };
+  }
+
+  const mediaFile = formData.get("media");
+
+  if (!(mediaFile instanceof File) || mediaFile.size === 0) {
+    return {
+      ...initialState,
+      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
+      success: false,
+      errors: { media: ["Debes subir una imagen para el post."] },
+    };
+  }
+
+  if (!mediaFile.type.startsWith("image/")) {
+    return {
+      ...initialState,
+      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
+      success: false,
+      errors: { media: ["El archivo debe ser una imagen."] },
+    };
+  }
+
+  let mediaPath: string;
+
+  try {
+    const bytes = await mediaFile.arrayBuffer();
+    const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);
+    const extension = mediaFile.type.split("/")[1] || "jpg";
+    const filename = `post-${session.user.id}-${Date.now()}.${extension}`;
+    const uploadDir = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads");
+
+    await mkdir(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
+    await writeFile(path.join(uploadDir, filename), buffer);
+
+    mediaPath = `/uploads/${filename}`;
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error("Error guardando la imagen:", error);
+    return {
+      ...initialState,
+      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
+      success: false,
+      errors: { _form: ["No se pudo guardar la imagen. Intenta nuevamente."] },
+    };
+  }
+
+  const { content, platforms, scheduleEnabled, scheduledDate, scheduledTime } = parsed.data;
+
+  const scheduledFor =
+    scheduleEnabled && scheduledDate && scheduledTime
+      ? new Date(`${scheduledDate}T${scheduledTime}:00`)
+      : null;
+
+  try {
+    await prisma.posts.create({
+      data: {
+        content,
+        media: mediaPath,
+        platforms,
+        status: scheduledFor ? "scheduled" : "draft",
+        ScheduledFor: scheduledFor,
+        userId: session.user.id,
+      },
+    });
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error("Error creando el post:", error);
+    return {
+      ...initialState,
+      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
+      success: false,
+      errors: { _form: ["No se pudo guardar el post. Intenta nuevamente."] },
+    };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    ...initialState,
+    id: crypto.randomUUID(),
+    success: true,
+    message: scheduledFor ? "Post programado correctamente." : "Post guardado como borrador.",
+  };
+}
+

diff --git a/src/app/post/imageUpload.tsx b/src/app/post/imageUpload.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..02ae234
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/app/post/imageUpload.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,156 @@
+"use client";
+
+import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react";
+import Cropper, { Area } from "react-easy-crop";
+import Image from "next/image";
+import { CloudUpload, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
+import Card from "@/components/Card";
+import Button from "@/components/Button";
+import { getCroppedImg } from "@/lib/cropImage";
+
+interface ImageUploadProps {
+    onImageReady: (file: File | null) => void;
+    error?: string[];
+}
+
+export default function ImageUpload({ onImageReady, error }: ImageUploadProps) {
+    const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
+    const [imageSrc, setImageSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+    const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
+    const [crop, setCrop] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
+    const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);
+    const [croppedAreaPixels, setCroppedAreaPixels] = useState<Area | null>(
+        null,
+    );
+
+    const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
+        const file = e.target.files?.[0];
+        if (!file) return;
+        setImageSrc(URL.createObjectURL(file));
+        setPreview(null);
+        onImageReady(null);
+    };
+
+    const onCropComplete = useCallback((_: Area, areaPixels: Area) => {
+        setCroppedAreaPixels(areaPixels);
+    }, []);
+
+    const handleConfirmCrop = async () => {
+        if (!imageSrc || !croppedAreaPixels) return;
+        const blob = await getCroppedImg(imageSrc, croppedAreaPixels);
+        const file = new File([blob], `post-${Date.now()}.jpg`, {
+            type: "image/jpeg",
+        });
+        setPreview(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
+        setImageSrc(null);
+        onImageReady(file);
+    };
+
+    const handleReset = () => {
+        setImageSrc(null);
+        setPreview(null);
+        setCroppedAreaPixels(null);
+        onImageReady(null);
+        if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = "";
+    };
+
+    return (
+        <Card className="bg-indigo-50 p-10 mb-2">
+            <input
+                ref={inputRef}
+                type="file"
+                accept="image/*"
+                className="hidden"
+                onChange={handleFileChange}
+            />
+
+            {!imageSrc && !preview && (
+                <div
+                    className="w-full text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer"
+                    onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}
+                >
+                    <div className="p-5 bg-white rounded-full text-indigo-600 mb-2 w-fit">
+                        <CloudUpload size={32} />
+                    </div>
+                    <div className="font-bold mb-2">
+                        Arrastra y suelta archivos
+                    </div>
+                    <div className="text-sm text-neutral-400 mb-10">
+                        Sube imagenes en alta resolucion (Max. 10MB)
+                    </div>
+                    <div className="font-bold text-indigo-600">
+                        Buscar archivos
+                    </div>
+                </div>
+            )}
+
+            {imageSrc && (
+                <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
+                    <div className="relative w-full h-[400px] bg-black rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
+                        <Cropper
+                            image={imageSrc}
+                            crop={crop}
+                            zoom={zoom}
+                            aspect={4/5}
+                            onCropChange={setCrop}
+                            onZoomChange={setZoom}
+                            onCropComplete={onCropComplete}
+                        />
+                    </div>
+                    <input
+                        type="range"
+                        min={1}
+                        max={3}
+                        step={0.1}
+                        value={zoom}
+                        onChange={(e) => setZoom(Number(e.target.value))}
+                    />
+                    <div className="flex gap-3">
+                        <Button
+                            type="button"
+                            variant="white"
+                            onClick={handleReset}
+                            className="flex-1"
+                        >
+                            Cancelar
+                        </Button>
+                        <Button
+                            type="button"
+                            variant="primary"
+                            onClick={handleConfirmCrop}
+                            className="flex-1"
+                        >
+                            Confirmar recorte
+                        </Button>
+                    </div>
+                </div>
+            )}
+
+            {preview && (
+                <div className="relative w-full flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
+                    <div className="relative w-48 h-48 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
+                        <Image
+                            src={preview}
+                            alt="preview"
+                            fill
+                            className="object-cover"
+                        />
+                    </div>
+                    <button
+                        type="button"
+                        onClick={handleReset}
+                        className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-indigo-600 font-bold"
+                    >
+                        <RotateCcw size={14} /> Cambiar imagen
+                    </button>
+                </div>
+            )}
+
+            {error?.map((err) => (
+                <p key={err} className="text-red-500 text-sm mt-2">
+                    {err}
+                </p>
+            ))}
+        </Card>
+    );
+}

diff --git a/src/app/post/schema.tsx b/src/app/post/schema.tsx

@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+import { z } from "zod";
+
+export const postSchema = z.object({
+    content: z
+        .string()
+        .min(1, "El contenido no puede estar vacío")
+        .max(2200, "El contenido es demasiado largo"),
+    platforms: z
+        .array(z.enum(["X", "Facebook", "Instagram", "Tiktok"]))
+        .min(1, "Selecciona al menos una red social"),
+    scheduleEnabled: z
+        .string()
+        .transform((v) => v === "true")
+        .default(false),
+    scheduledDate: z.string().optional(),
+    scheduledTime: z.string().optional(),
+})
+.superRefine((data, ctx) => {
+    if (data.scheduleEnabled) {
+        if (!data.scheduledDate) {
+            ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: "Selecciona una fecha", path: ["scheduledDate"] });
+        }
+        if (!data.scheduledTime) {
+            ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: "Selecciona una hora", path: ["scheduledTime"] });
+        }
+    }
+});
\ No newline at end of file

diff --git a/src/components/NavbarClient.tsx b/src/components/NavbarClient.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e618838
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/NavbarClient.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,213 @@
+"use client";
+
+import Link from "next/link";
+import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
+import { authClient } from "@/lib/auth-client";
+
+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import { SmilePlus, Menu, X } from "lucide-react";
+import Button from "@/components/Button";
+import Dropdown from "@/components/Dropdown";
+import DropdownItem from "@/components/DropdownItem";
+import Image from "next/image";
+
+const sections = [
+    { id: "", label: "Inicio" },
+    { id: "header", label: "Sobre el Proyecto" },
+    { id: "comunity", label: "Comunidad" },
+    { id: "join", label: "Unete a Nosotros" },
+];
+
+// Tipalo con el tipo real de tu sesión (el que devuelve auth.api.getSession / better-auth)
+type NavbarClientProps = {
+    session: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof authClient.getSession>>["data"];
+};
+
+export default function NavbarClient({ session }: NavbarClientProps) {
+    const router = useRouter();
+
+    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
+    const [active, setActive] = useState("");
+    const pathname = usePathname();
+
+    useEffect(() => {
+        const observers: IntersectionObserver[] = [];
+
+        sections.forEach(({ id }) => {
+            const element = document.getElementById(id);
+            if (!element) return;
+
+            const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
+                ([entry]) => {
+                    if (entry?.isIntersecting) {
+                        setActive(id);
+                    }
+                },
+                {
+                    root: null,
+                    rootMargin: "-50% 0px -50% 0px",
+                    threshold: 0,
+                }
+            );
+            observer.observe(element);
+            observers.push(observer);
+        });
+
+        return () => {
+            observers.forEach((observer) => observer.disconnect());
+        };
+    }, []);
+
+    const handleSignOut = async () => {
+        await authClient.signOut();
+        router.push("/login");
+        router.refresh(); 
+    };
+
+    return (
+        <nav className="fixed flex h-[80px] w-full px-4 md:px-8 lg:px-8 xl:px-8 text-gray-500 bg-neutral-50 z-90 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.12)]">
+            <div id="logo-container" className="absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2">
+                <Link href="/" className="flex flex-row gap-2 items-center text-black">
+                    <div>
+                        <SmilePlus size={30} />
+                    </div>
+                    <div>
+                        <span className="text-xl font-bold text-indigo-600">Social</span>
+                        <span className="text-xl">Optimizer</span>
+                    </div>
+                </Link>
+            </div>
+
+            <div id="nav-items-container" className="flex flex-row items-center mx-auto">
+                <ul className="md:flex grow hidden items-center gap-5">
+                    {sections.map(({ id, label }) => (
+                        <li key={`li_${id}`}>
+                            <Link
+                                key="{id}"
+                                href={`/#${id}`}
+                                className={`hover:text-indigo-600 hover:underline hover:underline-offset-8 hover:decoration-3 ${
+                                    pathname == `/#${id}` || active == id
+                                        ? "text-indigo-600 underline underline-offset-8 decoration-3"
+                                        : ""
+                                }`}
+                            >
+                                {label}
+                            </Link>
+                        </li>
+                    ))}
+                </ul>
+            </div>
+
+            <div id="auth-container" className="hidden md:flex absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2">
+                {session ? (
+                    <Dropdown
+                        trigger={
+                            <div className="flex flex-row items-center">
+                                <div className="flex flex-col text-end me-2">
+                                    <div className="font-bold text-md text-black">
+                                        {session.user.name}
+                                    </div>
+                                    <div className="text-neutral-500 text-xs font-normal uppercase">
+                                        Usuario
+                                    </div>
+                                </div>
+                                <Image
+                                    src={session.user.avatar}
+                                    alt="Perfil"
+                                    width={50}
+                                    height={50}
+                                    className="rounded-full border-3 border-indigo-600"
+                                />
+                            </div>
+                        }
+                    >
+                        <DropdownItem onClick={() => router.push("/dashboard")} className="cursor-pointer">
+                            Dashboard
+                        </DropdownItem>
+                        <DropdownItem onClick={() => router.push("/profile")} className="cursor-pointer">
+                            Mi Perfil
+                        </DropdownItem>
+                        <DropdownItem onClick={() => handleSignOut()} className="cursor-pointer">
+                            Cerrar Sesión
+                        </DropdownItem>
+                    </Dropdown>
+                ) : (
+                    <ul className="md:flex items-center gap-5">
+                        <li>
+                            <Link href="/login">Ingresar</Link>
+                        </li>
+                        <li>
+                            <Link href="/register">
+                                <Button variant="primary" className="font-bold">
+                                    Acceso Gratuito
+                                </Button>
+                            </Link>
+                        </li>
+                    </ul>
+                )}
+            </div>
+
+            <button
+                aria-label="menu-btn"
+                type="button"
+                className="menu-btn inline-block md:hidden active:scale-90 transition cursor-pointer"
+                onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
+            >
+                {isOpen ? <X /> : <Menu />}
+            </button>
+
+            <div
+                className={`mobile-menu absolute top-[70px] left-0 w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-violet-600 p-6 transition-full md:hidden ${
+                    isOpen ? "block" : "hidden"
+                }`}
+            >
+                <ul className="flex flex-col space-y-4 text-white text-lg">
+                    {sections.map(({ id, label }) => (
+                        <li key={`li_${id}`}>
+                            <Link
+                                key="{id}"
+                                href={`/#${id}`}
+                                className="ms-6 text-sm hover:text-white-600 hover:underline hover:underline-offset-8 hover:decoration-3"
+                            >
+                                {label}
+                            </Link>
+                        </li>
+                    ))}
+                </ul>
+
+                <div id="auth-container-mobile">
+                    {session ? (
+                        <div className="flex flex-col ms-6">
+                            <hr className="my-5 bg-white w-50 h-1 rounded opacity-40" />
+                            <div className="text-white hover:text-white-600 mb-5">
+                                Wenas, {session.user.name}
+                                <Button
+                                    variant="white"
+                                    onClick={() => handleSignOut()}
+                                    className="font-bold mt-5 rounded-lg"
+                                >
+                                    Cerrar Sesión
+                                </Button>
+                            </div>
+                        </div>
+                    ) : (
+                        <ul className="flex flex-col space-y-4 text-white text-lg mt-5">
+                            <li className="ms-6 text-sm hover:text-white-600 hover:underline hover:underline-offset-8 hover:decoration-3 text-white-600">
+                                <Link href="/login" className="font-bold">
+                                    Ingresar
+                                </Link>
+                            </li>
+                            <li className="ms-6 text-sm">
+                                <Link href="/register">
+                                    <Button variant="white" className="font-bold rounded-lg">
+                                        Acceso Gratuito
+                                    </Button>
+                                </Link>
+                            </li>
+                        </ul>
+                    )}
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </nav>
+    );
+}
\ No newline at end of file

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..66e0f94
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/Select.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+"use client";
+
+import {
+  forwardRef,
+  SelectHTMLAttributes,
+  ReactNode,
+} from "react";
+import { ChevronDown } from "lucide-react";
+import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
+
+interface SelectProps
+  extends SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement> {
+  label?: string;
+  error?: string;
+  startAdornment?: ReactNode;
+}
+
+export const Select = forwardRef<HTMLSelectElement, SelectProps>(
+  (
+    {
+      label,
+      error,
+      className,
+      id,
+      startAdornment,
+      children,
+      ...props
+    },
+    ref
+  ) => {
+    return (
+      <div className="w-full">
+        {label && (
+          <label
+            htmlFor={id}
+            className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1"
+          >
+            {label}
+          </label>
+        )}
+
+        <div
+          className={cn(
+            "flex w-full items-center rounded-xl border bg-neutral-50 transition",
+            "border-gray-300 focus-within:border-indigo-500 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-indigo-500/20",
+            "disabled:opacity-50",
+            error &&
+              "border-red-500 focus-within:border-red-500 focus-within:ring-red-500/20"
+          )}
+        >
+          {startAdornment && (
+            <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center pl-4 text-gray-500">
+              {startAdornment}
+            </div>
+          )}
+
+          <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0">
+            <select
+              ref={ref}
+              id={id}
+              className={cn(
+                "w-full appearance-none bg-transparent px-4 py-3 pr-10 outline-none",
+                "disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
+                className
+              )}
+              {...props}
+            >
+              {children}
+            </select>
+
+            <ChevronDown
+              size={20}
+              className="pointer-events-none absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-500"
+            />
+          </div>
+        </div>
+
+        {error && (
+          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-red-500">
+            {error}
+          </p>
+        )}
+      </div>
+    );
+  }
+);
+
+Select.displayName = "Select";
+
+export default Select;

diff --git a/src/components/ui/button.tsx b/src/components/ui/button.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ed3ca9a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/ui/button.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+import { Button as ButtonPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/button"
+import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
+import { cn } from "cn"
+
+const buttonVariants = cva(
+  "group/button inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent bg-clip-padding text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all outline-none select-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 active:not-aria-[haspopup]:translate-y-px disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-3 aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:border-destructive/50 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
+  {
+    variants: {
+      variant: {
+        default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/80",
+        outline:
+          "border-border bg-background shadow-xs hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground aria-expanded:bg-muted aria-expanded:text-foreground dark:border-input dark:bg-input/30 dark:hover:bg-input/50",
+        secondary:
+          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-[color-mix(in_oklch,var(--secondary),var(--foreground)_5%)] aria-expanded:bg-secondary aria-expanded:text-secondary-foreground",
+        ghost:
+          "hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground aria-expanded:bg-muted aria-expanded:text-foreground dark:hover:bg-muted/50",
+        destructive:
+          "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/20 focus-visible:border-destructive/40 focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/20 dark:hover:bg-destructive/30 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40",
+        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
+      },
+      size: {
+        default:
+          "h-9 gap-1.5 px-2.5 in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-md has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-2 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-2",
+        xs: "h-6 gap-1 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),8px)] px-2 text-xs in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-md has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",
+        sm: "h-8 gap-1 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),10px)] px-2.5 in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-md has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5",
+        lg: "h-10 gap-1.5 px-2.5 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-2 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-2",
+        icon: "size-9",
+        "icon-xs":
+          "size-6 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),8px)] in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-md [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",
+        "icon-sm":
+          "size-8 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),10px)] in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-md",
+        "icon-lg": "size-10",
+      },
+    },
+    defaultVariants: {
+      variant: "default",
+      size: "default",
+    },
+  }
+)
+
+function Button({
+  className,
+  variant = "default",
+  size = "default",
+  ...props
+}: ButtonPrimitive.Props & VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants>) {
+  return (
+    <ButtonPrimitive
+      data-slot="button"
+      className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  )
+}
+
+export { Button, buttonVariants }

+"use client";
+
+import { useTheme } from "next-themes";
+import { Toaster as Sonner, type ToasterProps } from "sonner";
+import {
+    CircleCheckIcon,
+    InfoIcon,
+    TriangleAlertIcon,
+    OctagonXIcon,
+    Loader2Icon,
+} from "lucide-react";
+
+const Toaster = ({ ...props }: ToasterProps) => {
+    const { theme = "system" } = useTheme();
+
+    return (
+        <Sonner
+            theme={theme as ToasterProps["theme"]}
+            richColors
+            className="toaster group"
+            position="top-right"
+            offset={{ top: "100px" }}
+            duration={10000}
+            icons={{
+                success: <CircleCheckIcon className="size-4" />,
+                info: <InfoIcon className="size-4" />,
+                warning: <TriangleAlertIcon className="size-4" />,
+                error: <OctagonXIcon className="size-4" />,
+                loading: <Loader2Icon className="size-4 animate-spin" />,
+            }}
+            style={
+                {
+                    "--normal-bg": "var(--popover)",
+                    "--normal-text": "var(--popover-foreground)",
+                    "--normal-border": "var(--border)",
+                    "--border-radius": "var(--radius)",
+
+                    "--success-bg": "#16a34a",
+                    "--success-text": "#ffffff",
+                    "--success-border": "#15803d",
+                    "--success-radius": "var(--radius)",
+
+                    "--error-bg": "#dc2626",
+                    "--error-text": "#ffffff",
+                    "--error-border": "#b91c1c",
+                } as React.CSSProperties
+            }
+            toastOptions={{
+                classNames: {
+                    toast: "cn-toast",
+                },
+            }}
+            {...props}
+        />
+    );
+};
+
+export { Toaster };

+export { cn } from "cn"
